message.content: {"note_claim": "The real Tesla Roadster demo took place on October 15, 2026 at SpaceX's McGregor, Texas test site, involving ramp suction and short-duration cold-gas propulsion, not city rooftop hovering.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The October 15 demo at SpaceX's McGregor, Texas site happened exactly as shown: the Roadster hung upside down on fan suction, fired compressed-air thrusters to flip and land, and hopped a line of Teslas.", "reason": "The page directly confirms the date, location, and nature of the real demo (fan suction + cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX McGregor), substantiating the note's claim that the authentic event was not a city rooftop hover."}

parsed.note_claim: The real Tesla Roadster demo took place on October 15, 2026 at SpaceX's McGregor, Texas test site, involving ramp suction and short-duration cold-gas propulsion, not city rooftop hovering.
